templates.title: tagave
templates.name: tagave
templates.description: A home for your music: catalogues the albums you own, finds what is missing and fixes tags. Postgres, the web app and both workers on one host.
templates.note: Fill in a database password, an app secret (at least 32 characters, e.g. the output of openssl rand -hex 32) and the host folder with your music. Open the app on port 3100 (or the port you chose) and register /mnt/music as the music folder. To update, set TAGAVE_VERSION to the new release and redeploy with Re-pull image on.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password
env.description: A long random password, letters and digits only. Keep a copy: it opens your catalogue.

env.name: APP_SECRET
env.label: App secret
env.description: At least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). It encrypts stored provider tokens; keep a copy and never change it.

env.name: MUSIC_DIR
env.label: Music folder on the host
env.description: Absolute path, e.g. /srv/music. Mounted read-only at /mnt/music.

env.name: TAGAVE_VERSION
env.label: Version
env.description: Image tag, e.g. 0.4.1. Pin a release so a redeploy never changes version by surprise.
